subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant thread status show sanitized per-tool progress labels, or remain generic while loading messages, draft previews, reactions, and task cards carry tool visibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the best behavior is a Slack UX and disclosure-policy choice rather than a narrow broken-code repair.

options.title: Defer Behind Visibility Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide native per-tool status together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding another Slack-visible progress surface.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Add per-tool native status updates from the shared sanitized progress model, with dedupe, final clear coverage, focused tests, and redacted live Slack proof.

options.title: Reject Native Duplication
options.body: Document that native status stays generic and that tool visibility belongs only in loading messages, draft previews, reactions, or task cards.

recommendation.title: Defer Behind Visibility Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide native per-tool status together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding another Slack-visible progress surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work changed Slack native-status defaults and preserved the assistant status wording, making this the closest decision owner in current history.
